notes.title: Small update - teleport
notes.notes:
Small update will minor fixes and features
- teleport ability
- building fixes

You are now able to teleport using command teleport.player (player is the name of the player). The player can allow teleport by activating using 't' key. Pressing again deactivates teleport.
